column1: # gate-dataflow.tsv — INVARIANT 6's registry: THE DATAFLOW half of the Rust-twin guard.
# `lean-twins.tsv` asks "is the SYMBOL still there?". That question was green the whole time
# `turn/src/executor/atomic.rs` was falling through from a missing `dregg_cross_cell_conserves`
# oracle into the hand-written Rust `BlockConservation` decider — on NATIVE, at the
# ASSET-INFLATION boundary, the twin that already produced one CRITICAL bug. A name-whitelist
# cannot see a fallthrough.
# This registry asks the question that catches the CLASS: at each site that routes a decision
# through a verified Lean gate, WHEN THE GATE IS ABSENT, can control reach an ACCEPTING verdict?
# `scripts/ci-invariants/gate-dataflow.py` extracts the gate-absent region (else-arm / `None`|`Err`
# match arm / `let..else` / `unwrap_or*` default / the fallthrough after `if let Some(gate)`),
# resolves same-file helper calls two levels deep, skips `#[cfg(test)]` definitions, and requires
# the region to REFUSE.
# COLUMNS (tab-separated; blank lines and #-comments ignored):
#   file       the source file owning the live decision (FATAL if it moved — re-point the row)
#   fn         the enclosing decision function (FATAL if no non-cfg(test) definition exists)
#   acquire    regex matching the GATE ACQUISITION inside `fn` (the call whose None/Err is the
#              "no verified gate" case)
#   allow      `|`-separated DECLARED carve-outs, or `-` for none. Two kinds:
#                <token>          a DISCRIMINATION that may guard a non-verified arm (a cfg
#                                 predicate fragment, or a named runtime escape). The non-exempt
#                                 arm must STILL refuse, or the row is red.
#                narrow:<token>   the no-gate path IS this named, deliberately narrowed local
#                                 decision (needs no Lean), accepted as the disposition.
#   note       one line — which twin, and what the no-gate disposition is
# THE POINT OF THE `allow` COLUMN: a carve-out becomes a DECLARED, DIFFABLE FACT. Widening one is
# a reviewable TSV diff. Forgetting to declare it is RED. Declaring one the code does not contain
# is ALSO red (the checker still demands the refusal). An UNREGISTERED new gate site is invisible
# to this file — add a row when you add a gate; `lean-twins.tsv` FATALs if a site file moves.
# file
# ── twin#1 per-asset conservation — THE ASSET-INFLATION BOUNDARY, the reason this file exists ──
# Pre-fix this row was RED: the fallthrough was a bare `Self::unverified_rust_conservation_fallback(..)`
# under NO cfg at all, so a native node with a stale/absent libdregg_lean.a silently answered the
# Σδ=0 question with the drifting Rust twin. Native now REFUSES; the Rust arithmetic survives only
# where an archive cannot exist (wasm32 / zkVM guest) or in debug builds that opt out of the
# fail-closed gate, and `DREGG_REQUIRE_LEAN=1` promotes even those to a refusal.
turn/src/executor/atomic.rs
